in.rationale: The hand-model trace theorem checks outcome and oracle-query totals on every shape-valid tape (sourceValid), but does not prove the executable source implements that model. Its oracle-query totals exclude protocol Bernoulli draws, whereas the selected replays' total_draw_calls_including_protocol include them.

sources.title: Hand-model source-order trace and query proof

state_meaning: A machine check (for example a Lean proof check) passed for the stated scope only; meaning is not reviewed.
text: Lean checks that a source-order observation model agrees with the hand-translated pyRun result on every shape-valid full tape. Its oracle-query totals are 596954 for a first challenge, 770042 for a second-step challenge, and 346176 for two accepts; protocol Bernoulli draws are excluded. This is not a theorem about CPython execution.
title: Hand-model outcome and query totals on shape-valid tapes
